top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards an original, mature and independently confirmed chain of discovery, from proglucagon processing and the incretin effect to identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1 peptide, that made incretin-based therapies for type 2 diabetes and obesity possible and is now validated by outcome trials. The allocation to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov covers the physiology and the active form of the hormone within the three-laureate limit, and the citation is scoped to the discovery rather than to any one product. No award is clearly inferior given this strength of evidence.
